# Learn JavaScript Online

> > Interactive JavaScript course teaching modern ES2015+ features, async/await, DOM manipulation, API integration, and real-world projects with certification.

Learn JavaScript Online is a beginner-friendly, project-based learning platform created by David that offers a comprehensive JavaScript curriculum. The course covers modern JavaScript (ECMAScript), Promises, Fetch API, JSON, DOM manipulation, and emerging technologies like Web Components and Lit, with a focus on practical, hands-on coding challenges.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- ECMAScript
- ES2015+
- Async/Await
- Promises
- Fetch API
- JSON
- DOM Manipulation
- API Integration
- Web Components
- Lit
- Modern JavaScript
- Project-Based Learning
- Real-World Projects
- Certification
